overview: Grammar se operator precedence/associativity; expression value evaluation with given rules.
coreConcept: Grammar me jo operator start symbol ke paas hota hai (upar) uski precedence kam; recursion left me ho to left associative.
hinglishExplanation: E -> E + T | T me + left associative aur kam precedence. Right recursion (E -> T ^ E) right associative. Value evaluation me precedence phir associativity apply.
formalDefinition: Grammar me jo operator start symbol ke paas hota hai (upar) uski precedence kam; recursion left me ho to left associative.
importantProperties: Lower in grammar hierarchy = higher precedence.
Left recursion => left associative; right recursion => right associative.
Ambiguity ke liye precedence/assoc rules add karte hain.
